name_en: Comparison theorem for differential inequalities and ODE solutions (exact theorem identity open)
canonical_name: Comparison theorem (catalog label; exact theorem identity open)
literal_source_claim: 微分不等式与解的比较 (comparison of differential inequalities and solutions)
statement_blocker: The repository gives only a generic ODE comparison-theorem title and topic gloss. It does not choose scalar or ordered-vector state, functions or sub/supersolutions, an ODE vector field, interval and direction, derivative notion, regularity, uniqueness or monotonicity premises, initial order, strictness, boundary cases, or qualitative versus quantitative conclusion. Selecting a fencing, sub/supersolution, trajectory-distance, Gronwall, or other comparison theorem would infer or substitute mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix scalar versus ordered-vector state, topology and order structures, the time interval, state-space universes, and any normed-space or finite-dimensional assumptions.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not say whether the result preserves weak or strict pointwise order, prevents crossing, compares a subsolution to an exact solution, yields an exponential or nonlinear bound, or proves another comparison consequence.
candidate_scope_not_credited: a scalar fencing theorem deriving f(t) <= B(t) on a forward interval from initial order and source-selected derivative inequalities
a scalar subsolution/supersolution comparison theorem for y' = F(t,y) under source-selected existence, uniqueness, Lipschitz, or monotonicity hypotheses
an order-preservation theorem for cooperative or quasimonotone systems in a source-selected ordered space
a quantitative distance bound for exact or approximate ODE trajectories under a Lipschitz vector field
a Gronwall-type differential or integral inequality only if the source and neighboring-target crosswalk select it
excluded_degenerate_cases: empty or reversed intervals and whether a <= b is explicit or implicit
initial equality versus weak or strict initial order
right endpoint, left endpoint, or interior initial time and forward versus backward comparison
ordinary, within-set, one-sided Dini, liminf-slope, almost-everywhere, or integral derivative formulations
strict inequality at first contact versus non-strict inequality everywhere
nonunique ODE solutions and any selected minimal or maximal solution convention
scalar order versus componentwise, cone, lattice, or other ordered-state formulations
local versus maximal or global solutions and exit from the comparison domain
zero Lipschitz or growth constants and zero initial separation
excluded_substitutions: Gronwall inequality, separately cataloged as THM-M-1337
Bihari-LaSalle inequality, separately cataloged as THM-M-1338
ODE existence, uniqueness, continuation, continuous-dependence, or stability theorems substituted for comparison
one scalar fencing lemma silently generalized to an ordered system or silently weakened from a source-selected system theorem
one quantitative trajectory-distance estimate silently substituted for a qualitative subsolution comparison theorem
a vacuous interval case, a single explicit ODE example, or a structure projection substituted for the general root
generic calculus or ODE APIs treated as source identity or proof credit
the catalog label 已验证 treated as source, statement, or machine evidence
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical choice, quotient, order, topology, calculus, and ODE policies remain open until an exact proposition is selected
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports, expression identity, axioms, and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No numerical solver, simulation, phase portrait, oracle, unchecked certificate, or sampled trajectory is credited
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source identity or edition, selected comparison principle, state space or order, interval, derivative, solution, vector-field, regularity, monotonicity, uniqueness, strictness, boundary or neighboring-target decision, Lean target, dependency pin, assurance profile, validator, or any owned artifact change; independent source and formal reviewers remain required.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. No primary source or unique proposition is selected, and no canonical Lean target is frozen. Candidate pinned APIs are discovery hints only. No H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, theorem completion, or master acceptance is claimed.
